scientific_integrity: Proof of universal strict period monotonicity, exact extremal grid, and quantitative exponential convergence is given. Rational and floating-point replay checks supplement but do not replace the analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Only standard unweighted Cartesian products of cycles with both periods at least three, one exact Crank–Nicolson end-step, and unit normalized combinatorial-Laplacian rate. Does not cover anisotropic or weighted grids, nonperiodic boundaries, nonlinear positivity or accuracy selection. The square-lattice elliptic Green function and the general resolvent positivity criterion are prior work. A cited 2022 periodic-diffusion manuscript was not accessible and equivalent prior work remains a risk.
title: Strict positivity-frontier monotonicity for Crank–Nicolson diffusion on rectangular discrete tori
